summary.en: Sign in to CNB (cnb.cool) with a browser device code, see your monthly AI Credit and identity badges, and run DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi through the CNB AI endpoint or your own relay.
summary.zh: 用浏览器设备码登录 CNB（cnb.cool），在 magpie 里看当月 AI Credit 与认证徽章，并通过 CNB 的 AI 端点或自建中继跑 DeepSeek / GLM / Kimi。
